parameters.name: client_id

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Filters the program if title contains this value

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Filters program since scheduled_at ISO datetime.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Filters program until scheduled_at ISO datetime.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Returns active/inactive programs based on active values(true/false)

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: future: Returns programs, which have scheduled_at > current_time. past: Returns programs, which have scheduled_at < current_time, live: Returns programs, which are not yet stopped.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Filters program on the basis of their attributes, ?attributes=key:value

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: scheduled_at, started_at, stopped_at, created_at. For descending order use "-" eg. -scheduled_at.
